name: Juni XR
summary:
Juni XR is a hands-free AI assistant for mixed reality. Ask out loud, and it sees what you see and walks you through the task in front of you, one step at a time.

• Ask out loud. Hold a natural spoken conversation, so you never have to stop what you're doing to look something up.

• It sees what you see. Look at a machine you've never used and ask "How do I use this?" It labels the parts and highlights each one as its step comes up.

• Step by step. Move through any task at your own pace. Say "next", "back
